title: I turn ideas
into systems.
intro.lead: I'm a data engineer at AEM Energy Solutions, building pipelines and analytics for the energy sector. I trained as a civil engineer, moved into data, and went on to a Master's in AI.
intro.body: Most of what I make starts as a question and ends as a system someone can use: a data platform, a model, a product, or an experiment that didn't work and taught me why.

title: From messy data
to data you can trust.
featured.lead: Data quality management, turned into a product.
featured.body: Fixing bad data usually happens in spreadsheets with no trail. QualityPlus scores it, lets people fix it inside a review workflow, and publishes a version everyone can rely on.

title: Same curiosity.
Different tracks.
aboutTeaser.body: Civil engineering taught me to respect systems. Data taught me to question them. I still work the same way: input, process, iterate, progress, whether it's a pipeline, a model or a long run.
